units: Fictional million domestic units; FX units at fixed illustrative conversion, energy GWh, water million cubic metres, staff distinct FTE
scope: Standalone eight-year enabling envelope; not a whole-country budget or production forecast
limits: All new prices, schedules, pay, supplies, export proceeds and grants/appropriations are authored, not observed or agreed.
A cash grant is assumed only to isolate the envelope; any actual borrowing must add rates, fees, repayment and creditor exposure. No actual source is verified.

Existing wages, taxes, baseline capital, private finance, benefits, pensions and remedies remain outside this envelope. Inclusion/overlap with old capital 60 is unresolved; no amounts are added to a national total.
Project costs split energy 60, water 30, records 18; training is current expense 12, not capital; salaries 16.8 per year remain payable during training and after construction.
Project imports are a component of project cash, operating imports a component of maintenance; do not count either twice in domestic expenditure.
Maintenance energy 10, water 4 and records 2 begins in year after hypothetical acceptance; assets are not credited until all scheduled obligations and FX are settled.

Monthly due dates, contracts, engineering, pollution, land, prices, private displacement, qualified roles and democratic control require independent actual evidence. Annual settlement cannot prove timely receipt.
Export receipts require willing exporter sale, receiving bank and law; private earnings are not Treasury property. Alternative currency/settlement routes remain live.
Water efficiency does not increase catchment; one independent safe usable source and actual measured saving must each be proven without counting the same return flow twice.
Earlier national income floor remains unfunded. Funding this envelope or commissioning supply does not itself finance that entitlement or produce larger GDP.
